params.name: childTypesArr
params.description: Receives the type of each child node: one of the 'XML' theme constants (comment=2, processing instruction=3, DATA=6, CDATA=7, DOCTYPE=10, ELEMENT=11)

params.name: nodeRefsArr
params.description: Receives, for each child node, its reference (for ELEMENT nodes) or its value (for content/instruction nodes)

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the types and references/values of all direct child nodes of an XML element.
